summary.name: ImagineArt
summary.one_liner: ImagineArt is a platform for generating images, video and audio with 50+ AI models, plus editing, brand-kit, workflow and studio tools for teams.
use_cases: Generate on-model fashion lookbooks and e-commerce shots
Create consistent brand campaigns across images and video
Edit specific frames with inpainting or relighting
Build automated creative pipelines and workflows
Produce product listing images and short videos for sellers
Use image and video generation from inside ChatGPT
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a single platform that generates images, video and audio using a choice of 50+ AI models, with eight named as switchable mid-workflow. It offers a node canvas for chaining models, tools and connectors into pipelines, and a brand kit that stores logos, colors, fonts and tone for use across outputs. Users can reference a product, character or presenter so it stays consistent across scenes and formats. Editing tools include inpainting, relighting, extending, captioning and camera-angle changes on existing frames. Enterprise features mentioned are SSO sign-in, roles, usage limits and an audit trail, plus stated encryption and a no-training data policy.
notable: Node canvas for chaining models, tools and connectors into one pipeline
Brand kit and reference system for consistent products, characters and presenters across models
Connects to AI assistants such as ChatGPT via MCP
Enterprise controls including SSO, audit trail and encrypted data
caveats: Page does not state specific paid plan prices or free-tier limits
Enterprise features such as SSO and audit trail are described as enterprise-tier capabilities
Performance figures on the page (40% faster turnaround, 30% lower cost) are vendor claims
